versions.description: semver range the pack is tested against

Pack.description: Pack is a parser pack (DESIGN.md section 5.2): what doriki knows about one engine's logs, as data.

PackDetect.description: PackDetect says how a pack is chosen for a pod (DESIGN.md section 5.3).

PackFact.description: PackFact is a one-shot manifest fact read from the log: the named group "v" of the first matching line.

start_from_duration.description:
StartFromDuration names a group holding a duration in seconds, on a marker whose ID ends
in ".end" for an engine that logs only how long a step took when it finishes. The
matching line also yields the ".start" marker, stamped that many seconds earlier, with
confidence at most DerivedStartConfidence and the attribute AttrStartDerived.

PackMarker.description: PackMarker turns matching log lines into marker events; named groups become the event's attributes.

PackTimestamp.description: PackTimestamp parses the engine's own timestamp from a log line: Regex has a named group "ts" and Layout is its Go time layout, without a year (the year comes from the container start).
